title: Corrections
description: Corrections log — Tokenization 2050 corrections and updates to published articles.
body:
# Corrections

Tokenization 2050 is committed to accuracy. When we make an error, we correct it promptly and transparently.

## Correction Policy

- Errors are corrected as soon as they are identified and verified.
- The original article is updated with the correction noted at the top.
- All corrections are logged on this page with the date, affected article, and details of the change.
- If an error is material (affects the meaning or conclusion), the article headline or summary is also updated.

## How to Report an Error

If you believe we have published inaccurate information, please email **[{{CONTACT_EMAIL}}](mailto:{{CONTACT_EMAIL}})** with:

1. A link to the article
2. The specific error
3. Supporting evidence (source links, documents, data)

We review all correction requests and respond within 48 hours.

---

## Corrections Log

*No corrections have been issued to date.*

---

*This page is updated whenever a correction is made to any article on Tokenization 2050.*
